independent_execution.interpretation: The exact repaired workspace compiles and its enabled local tests pass. The replacement stable receipt separately records two PostgreSQL runs, exact SBF construction/load, two-cycle D65 validation and 204 relation checks. No Devnet path was executed by this reviewer.

predecessor_finding_dispositions.evidence: Two decision files are now required, but repository_root and both decision paths remain envelope-controlled. The gate unit test creates an arbitrary temporary repository and hand-written accepted/authorized status objects and proves they pass. No trust anchor distinguishes owner-authored decisions from manufactured status fields.

Native loader instructions use one create transaction, 128 fixed 768-byte write transactions and one finalize transaction. Every serialized transaction is bounded by 1,232 bytes, all 130 submissions consume the deployment budget, and no retry path exists. The 192 deployment plus 24 protocol scope still requires the terminal owner decision and is not inherited from the old 24-total envelope.

The executor creates fresh program and buffer accounts, verifies finalized upgradeable-loader state and authority, reads finalized ProgramData bytes, requires byte equality with the exact local SBF, and records all deployment signatures, slots, fees, rent and the remote digest.
A, B and B2 public keys must be distinct; prepare/open for A and B plus rewrap/open for B2 occur before RPC effects. Seven Solana wallet public keys must be pairwise distinct before RPC effects.

The crypto adapter requires replacement binding ID SHA-256 and registered public key equality. Grant and reissue state now preserve the requested key commitment, envelope commitment and domain-separated tuple commitment; the executor verifies the tuple and B2 decryption. The program still relies on the originator-authorized off-chain construction rather than an on-chain HPKE proof.

After finalized grant and again after finalized reissue, the PostgreSQL pool is dropped and reconnected. Ciphertext and active envelopes are retrieved by exact locators and identities, reconstructed into material and used for B/B2 decryption.

artifact_version_id is now 32 random OS bytes and is the only artifact ID placed in PDA/public program state. The deterministic plaintext commitment remains off-chain and is emitted as a digest in decryption observation evidence, retaining dictionary leakage if that private evidence is later exposed.

Nine transaction cases plus six observation cases must equal all 15 authorized case IDs. Deployment and airdrop signatures/slots, deployment and protocol fees, finalized remote SBF, program/programdata rent, payer delta, storage observations and zero consideration are recorded. The funding requirement and protocol-account rent are not independently itemized.

An external create-new append journal is sync'd before each local submission, then records submit/finalized/ambiguous states. Existing journal blocks execution. Reconcile checks recorded signatures at finalized commitment and appends outcomes with zero resubmissions. Journal authenticity and full state reconstruction remain bounded residues.
The PostgreSQL URL must use postgres/postgresql and a loopback host; tls-none is therefore bounded to the local first adapter.
Every recovery append now acquires a transaction-scoped PostgreSQL advisory lock before selecting the chain head.
Initialization, grant, request and fulfillment reject zero commitments/operation identities, and grant rejects the default recipient public key.

Zeroizing covers file-loaded HPKE private bytes, plaintext and content keys, but filesystem permissions, memory locking, encrypted-at-rest custody and explicit Solana Keypair memory guarantees remain external host responsibilities.
The lockfile is exact, but the packet still has no current advisory scan, deny policy, SBOM/provenance attestation or license review.

Four gate tests cover budget, case/RPC policy and repository decision shape. Native deployment, journal/reconciliation, cross-layer coordinator and fault paths compile but lack local port-mocked or fault-injection tests.
Lean, TLC and Alloy remain deterministic abstract-model evidence with an explicit no-runtime-conformance ceiling; no machine-checked implementation refinement was added.

unresolved_findings.title: Repository decision status fields still have no non-self-assertable trust anchor
unresolved_findings.evidence: validate_governance_authority canonicalizes repository_root supplied by the envelope, then trusts any two JSON files under its decisions subdirectory whose selected fields say accepted and authorized. The unit test explicitly manufactures a temporary repository and these status fields and receives success. CA2_DEVNET_PACKET_DIGEST is likewise caller-supplied.
unresolved_findings.impact: A caller with external keys can create an alternate directory tree, self-assert both decisions and pass the technical gate. The repair separates decision objects but does not establish that the CyberAlchemy owner authored them.
unresolved_findings.required_disposition: Pin the canonical repository/decision source outside the envelope through a trusted launcher or compiled/OS-owned root, validate the owner-decision schema and provenance, and ensure a status-field edit alone cannot create acceptance or authorization. Human approval may bind intent rather than a digest, but its provenance must not be self-assertable.

unresolved_findings.title: On-chain tuple commitment does not prove HPKE decryptability
unresolved_findings.evidence: The program deterministically binds requested key commitment and supplied envelope commitment, while the authorized executor verifies B2 opening before and after effects. A direct originator caller can still commit an arbitrary nonzero envelope because Solana does not verify HPKE.
unresolved_findings.impact: The Devnet trial can prove decryptability for its exact evidence, but public state alone cannot prove a fulfilled request is usable by B.
unresolved_findings.required_disposition: Preserve the bounded claim or add recipient acknowledgment/proof before treating public fulfilled state alone as cryptographic fulfillment.

unresolved_findings.title: Terminal evidence contains a deterministic plaintext commitment
unresolved_findings.evidence: On-chain artifact identity is opaque, but recipient-decryption observations emit plaintext_commitment as output_sha256.
unresolved_findings.impact: Publishing or sharing the private evidence can permit equality and dictionary tests against low-entropy knowledge.
unresolved_findings.required_disposition: Keep evidence private or replace the exposed digest with a hiding/domain-separated evidence commitment before publication.

unresolved_findings.title: The durable journal is not tamper-evident or bound to one packet/trial
unresolved_findings.evidence: Records are fsync'd JSONL but contain no packet digest, trial ID, previous-record hash or authentication. Reconcile checks signature statuses but does not reconstruct deployment/program/artifact state.
unresolved_findings.impact: The no-resubmission behavior is explicit, but edited or cross-trial journals can make reconciliation incomplete or misleading.
unresolved_findings.required_disposition: Hash-link and packet-bind the journal, validate its schema/sequence, and add state reconciliation for deployment and protocol accounts.

unresolved_findings.title: Initial recipient directory bindings remain overwriteable and fingerprint semantics are not validated
unresolved_findings.evidence: RecipientKeyDirectory::register unconditionally replaces an entry. Reissue validates binding ID and registered public key, but initial prepare/open do not require binding_id SHA-256(public_key) or validate key_fingerprint derivation. The terminal executor constructs consistent bindings and pre-opens all recipients.
unresolved_findings.impact: The exact trial is preflight-safe, while other library callers can substitute initial directory records under an existing logical binding.
unresolved_findings.required_disposition: Make registration immutable/versioned and validate binding ID/fingerprint against public key for every prepare/open path.

unresolved_findings.title: The requested test-SOL amount is bounded but not independently calculated by the executor
unresolved_findings.evidence: calculated_test_sol_lamports is supplied by the authorized envelope. Evidence separates deployment/protocol fees, program/programdata rent and payer delta, but does not explicitly itemize artifact/replay/request rents or prove the pre-airdrop amount covers the exact 130-deployment and protocol plan.
unresolved_findings.impact: An underfunded authorized packet can fail after airdrop or partial deployment, and protocol rent separation requires derivation from aggregate balance delta.
unresolved_findings.required_disposition: Compute the required lamports from current finalized rent/fee queries before airdrop, bind the calculation, and itemize protocol account rents.

unresolved_findings.title: Disposable-file custody depends on external host controls
unresolved_findings.evidence: HPKE secret bytes and plaintext use Zeroizing, but file permissions, encrypted-at-rest custody, process memory locking and Solana Keypair zeroization are not enforced by this packet.
unresolved_findings.impact: The claim remains suitable only for disposable local Devnet identities on a trusted host.
unresolved_findings.required_disposition: Retain the current claim ceiling and require a hardened custody adapter before production use.

unresolved_findings.title: Exact dependency identity is not a vulnerability or provenance assessment
unresolved_findings.evidence: Cargo.lock pins RustCrypto, SQLx, Solana client/program/loader and serialization dependencies, but no current advisory, license, provenance or deny-policy evidence is joined.
unresolved_findings.impact: Known-vulnerability posture remains unevaluated for the exact lockfile.
unresolved_findings.required_disposition: Join a current bounded dependency security and policy assessment before stronger security claims.

unresolved_findings.title: The effect coordinator and native deployment path lack deterministic fault-injection tests
unresolved_findings.evidence: The workspace has 34 enabled passing tests and stable PostgreSQL/SBF evidence, but executor.rs has no tests for loader construction, 130-budget enforcement, journal ordering, ambiguous send/finality, reconciliation or 15-case evidence closure.
unresolved_findings.impact: The bounded Devnet trial would be the first integrated execution of these orchestration branches.
unresolved_findings.required_disposition: Introduce mockable RPC/storage/deployment ports and deterministic success/failure coordinator tests.

unresolved_findings.title: Abstract formal passes do not prove repaired implementation refinement
unresolved_findings.evidence: The formal provider receipt remains PASS_BOUNDED and explicitly denies Rust, SQL, Solana and external conformance beyond its model bounds.
unresolved_findings.impact: Formal evidence cannot discharge the implementation and authority residues in this review.
unresolved_findings.required_disposition: Preserve the claim ceiling or add a separately reviewed code-preservation/refinement layer.
